# PROB-21: owner-review contact sheet

**Predictions, not owner-approved shape definitions.** Images become visible after running `bash docs/research/shapes/render.sh` from the repo root with `fd` built. Every `![]()` link is relative to this document. Vote `agree` / `reject` / `uncertain` in the last column; no owner votes have been assumed.

96 distinct 320×180 cameras (6 positive and 6 negative for each of the eight hypotheses). The underlying catalog enumerates Misiurewicz parameters from exact rational rays of doubling preperiod ≤8 and period ≤4, plus `i`, `-2`, the input and v0. 19 distinct parameter coordinates occur in this selected sheet. No camera is reused as both positive and negative evidence.

## Mathematical status

**Established:** Douady–Hubbard's Hubbard tree is the regulated-arc hull of the finite postcritical orbit. The Bruin–Kaffl–Schleicher triod/kneading combinatorics determine an abstract incidence tree (BKS 2009, Proposition 3.5); Bruin–Schleicher (2008) develops arm dynamics and admissibility. Tan Lei (1990) proves an **asymptotic**, not finite-width exact, Julia-to-parameter similarity near Misiurewicz parameters.

**New, unproved:** All eight shape labels and thresholds, the derivative-based camera-width rule, chord-length estimates for regulated arc lengths, multiplier-log-radius models for edge turn, and extrapolated spiral densities. **This is an abstract angle-based triod tree, not a traced geometric Julia-set embedding.** Ray seeds are numerically integrated then Newton-refined; ray landing association is *not certified*. Branch coordinates are estimated from nearby orbit vertices in the abstract graph. Chord lengths are lower bounds for the unknown regulated arcs. Galaxy and whirlpool count **predicted scale levels**, not demonstrated nested minibrots. Spindle does not detect minibrots. All shortcuts decline when their numerical contract fails; no production shortcut was introduced.

**Known-case gate:** `c=i`: angle 1/6 gives max 3 arms. `c=-2`: angle 1/2 gives a segment with max 2 arms. `v0` retains q=24, p=2 and a checked Newton residual, but has **no authenticated external ray angle**, so its true arm count is **unknown**, not replaced by a chord proxy. Matching the rendered v0 spiral still requires an independently verified angle/owner check.

**Parameters:** Exact decimal strings are carried without binary float conversion. The view rule evaluates an explicit width/estimated-local-scale ratio: for ordinary branches, 0.01999 ≤ ratio ≤ 5, with additional predicate thresholds below. This produces candidate **view-specific** labels; the local geometry estimate is not validated by Julia arc tracing.

**Numerical contract and owner review:** On ray/refinement/triod/residual/repelling-cycle failure, exclude that seed rather than label it. The six yes and six no are algorithmic predictions, not verified examples. The owner must reject misleading images, especially extrapolated galaxy/whirlpool and widths outside a visually useful scale.

References: [Douady–Hubbard Orsay Notes](https://pi.math.cornell.edu/~hubbard/OrsayEnglish.pdf); [Bruin–Kaffl–Schleicher 2009](https://doi.org/10.4064/fm202-3-4); [Bruin–Schleicher 2008](https://doi.org/10.1112/jlms/jdn033); [Tan Lei 1990](https://doi.org/10.1007/BF02097356); [Munafo Mu-Ency](https://www.mrob.com/pub/muency.html).
